verdict.rationale: Recruitee is a SaaS recruiting platform, so an official CLI is a reasonable thing for a buyer to ask about and the axis applies. The evidence documents only a REST API with bearer-token auth, webhooks, llms.txt and markdown docs, with no mention of any official command-line tool. API endpoints are developer building blocks, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
